note: Synthetic overnight news written for the template's test runs. The items are not real reports; each link is the publisher's front page, not an article.

items.title: Fed governor says further cuts are warranted if hiring keeps slowing
items.text: A Federal Reserve governor said further rate cuts are warranted if hiring keeps slowing, and that the labour market no longer looks tight. Markets moved toward a December cut.

items.title: BoJ deputy governor keeps a hike in play for next meeting
items.text: The Bank of Japan deputy governor said a rate hike remains in play for the next meeting if wage data hold up. The yen strengthened in Asian trade after the remarks.

items.title: ECB board member sees no case for another cut this year
items.text: An ECB board member said services inflation is still too sticky and there is no case for another cut this year. Euro area rate expectations firmed.

items.title: US 10-year yield falls 9 basis points to 3.86%
items.text: The US 10-year Treasury yield fell 9 basis points to 3.86% as softer labour signals pulled rate expectations lower. A lower yield gap tends to weigh on the dollar against the euro.

items.title: US CPI for September is released today at 12:30 UTC
items.text: The US consumer price index for September is released today at 12:30 UTC. It is a tier-one scheduled release for every USD pair.

items.title: Retail traders are 78% long EURUSD, the most in a year
items.text: Retail traders are 78% long EURUSD, the most crowded reading in a year and 5.4 standard deviations above its 30-day normal. Crowded retail longs often unwind when the pair turns lower.

items.title: Speculators add to yen shorts in the latest COT report
items.text: Speculators added to yen net shorts in the latest Commitments of Traders report, which reflects Tuesday positions. The change is 1.2 standard deviations from its 30-day normal.

items.title: EURUSD holds inside its Asian range
items.text: EURUSD spent the Asian session inside a narrow range below last week's high, with no break in either direction.

items.title: Talk of yen intervention doubles headline volume
items.text: Headlines mentioning yen intervention ran at twice their usual volume overnight after a finance ministry official said officials are watching moves with urgency. The yen firmed on the comments.

items.title: Oil rises 3% on supply worries
items.text: Crude oil rose 3% on supply worries. The move matters most for commodity currencies.

items.title: Bank of England official flags gradual easing
items.text: A Bank of England official said easing would stay gradual.

items.title: Regional Fed president urges patience on rates
items.text: A regional Federal Reserve president urged patience on rates and said the outlook is balanced.

items.title: Japanese exporters sell dollars into the month-end fix
items.text: Japanese exporters were reported selling dollars into the month-end fix, adding to yen demand through the Asian session.

items.title: ECB chief economist says wage growth is still too strong
items.text: The ECB chief economist said wage growth is still too strong to justify faster easing. The euro firmed against the dollar after the remarks.

items.title: US two-year yield drops to a six-month low
items.text: The US two-year Treasury yield dropped to a six-month low as traders priced more Fed cuts, weighing on the dollar across the majors.

items.title: Yen call options see heavy demand
items.text: Demand for yen call options rose sharply overnight as traders hedged against a sharp yen rally.
